test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ali Akbar Khan, a globally renowned musician, is famous for playing which of the following instruments in the west at the invitation of violinist Yehudi Menuhin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarod.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ali Akbar Khan is known for playing the music instrument Sarod**.
 
• The sarod is a stringed instrument used mainly in Hindustani music.
 
• **Ali Akbar Khan was a Hindustani classical musician of the Maihar Gharana.**
 
• He established a music school in Calcutta in 1956, and the Ali Akbar College of Music in 1967.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Santoor**

 
• **The Indian santoor instrument is a trapezoid-shaped hammered dulcimer.**
 
• ​It is a traditional instrument in Jammu and Kashmir and dates back to ancient times.
 
• **It was called Shatha Tantri Veena in ancient Sanskrit texts.**
 
• The santoor is played while sitting in an asana called Ardha-padmasana and placing it on the lap.

**Surbahar**

 
• **Surbahar is a larger version of the sitar.** The instrument was developed during the early years of the 19th Century in India
 
• Annapurna Devi was a maestro in playing Surbahar. She was a recipient of the Padma Bhushan award.

**Sitar**

 
• **The sitar is a plucked stringed instrument, originating from the Indian subcontinent, used in Hindustani classical music.**
 
• The instrument was made of wood. It had a thin violin-type of the bridge and it was played by a plectrum worn on the right hand.
 
• It was invented by Amir Khusrau.
